static_traits.name: Lin Anqi
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends to confide in; has some social support
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; has not yet received psychotherapy before; first time experiencing this level of anxiety and stress
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent thinking, high cooperativeness; subjective experience of intense anxiety and worry

basic_info.main_problem: With my wife's recent unemployment, I am experiencing intense anxiety and stress, constantly catastrophizing that she will never find new work. As time passes and she has not yet found new work, my worries about the future and family finances grow more serious, affecting work focus, sleep, and appetite, and causing tension in the marriage.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling to learn coping strategies and find ways to manage these emotions, thereby reducing the impact of anxiety and stress on work focus and life.

core_beliefs: Once the economy becomes unstable, the consequences will be catastrophic

special_situations.event: Receiving yet another rejection letter for the wife's job application
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If rejected multiple times, it means she will not find work in the future either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessively focuses on application and reply progress, repeatedly rehearsing the worst scenarios in the mind to 'be prepared'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She may never find new work

special_situations.event: Seeing my wife keep submitting resumes but with no response for now
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no obvious progress in a short time, it means things are heading toward failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles self-pressure, closely monitors progress, repeatedly adjusts budgets and plans to try to control risks

special_situations.event: Thinks about family finances and mortgage/savings at bedtime at night
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I, as the sole income source, have any mishap, the family will collapse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly calculates the budget and imagines worst outcomes to gain a sense of safety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: We might run out of savings and lose the house

special_situations.event: Wife's unemployment lasting weeks with no new job yet
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If work is not found now, it means it will never be found (black-and-white thinking)
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Judging progress by extreme standards, treating 'not immediately succeeding' as 'total failure'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This means she will not be hired again

core_conflict.wish: Longing for family stability and safety, and sharing economic pressure with the partner
core_conflict.fear: Fearing losing control, family finances collapsing, and quality of life declining
defense_goal: Maintaining a sense of control by anticipating worst-case scenarios and staying vigilant, reducing anxiety from uncertainty

object_relations.self_representation: Anxious, a caretaker/guardian who must shoulder the family's finances
object_relations.object_representation: A partner in unemployment and uncertainty, needing support with a hard-to-control outlook

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about the wife's job-search setbacks or family financial uncertainty
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating uncertainty with impending disaster; believing risks can only be avoided through constant worry and planning
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Calm tone; concretizing and structured questioning; guiding focus on controllable small steps and real evidence, gently limiting catastrophic extrapolation, affirming actual coping already taken.

manifestations: Feels heavy pressure and isolation in the role of the family's main/only source of income
Experiencing helplessness and unease when facing an uncertain future and financial risks
Spousal relationship is tense due to stress, subjectively aggravating the feeling of 'carrying it alone'
outcomes: Attention and decline in work performance

positive_force: Strong motivation to seek help, actively seeking professional help
Keeps in touch with several close friends; has some social support
Able to generate more balanced alternative views in discussion (willing to practice de-catastrophizing)
Has budgeting and planning awareness; willing to take practical measures
negative_force: Catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and black-and-white thinking prominent
Highly sensitive to financial uncertainty; tending to maintain a sense of control through worry
Disturbed sleep and dietary changes, weakening emotional regulation and work focus
Increasing stress and anxiety reactions in the role as the primary financial provider
Reacting strongly to negative cues such as rejection letters, ignoring other possibilities

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent catastrophic worry (focused on his wife's re-employment and family finances)
antecedent: Seeing his wife's resume submissions or slow application progress
Received a job application rejection letter
Thinking about family finances and future uncertainty
target_behavior.core_reason: Financial uncertainty and role pressure triggered by the wife's unemployment, accompanied by overestimation of worst outcomes and threat monitoring
target_behavior.function: Gaining a sense of control and prevention through repeated worrying, to avoid anxiety from uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased work focus, impaired efficiency; relationship tension with partner; persistent anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Difficulty falling asleep and nighttime rumination
antecedent: At bedtime at night, thinks of family finances and his wife's job search progress
target_behavior.core_reason: High vigilance toward the uncertain future and catastrophic imagination maintain physiological and cognitive arousal
target_behavior.function: Trying to seek certainty and a sense of control through constant thinking and rehearsing scenarios
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient sleep leading to next-day attention and decline in work performance, further aggravating anxiety and stress
